subject: Contract-to-live playlist & canary training — AuroraTech
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@auroratech.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com; laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Contract signed — next steps to production

Thanks Rachel — contract countersigned this morning, thanks for driving. Our implementation lead (impl@auroratech.com) is looped here.

High level asks from our side so we can align procurement and infra:
- A mutual action plan embedded in the contract (we'd like milestones we can tie to invoices).
- A canary window and rollback criteria for our payments service (we process auths at peak times).
- A training schedule for our SREs and devs (ideally two 90-min sessions).

Can you put together a single doc that has the MAP + evaluation grid + training slots? If you can include a short SOC2 evidence checklist that would speed vendor security sign-off.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, AuroraTech

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@auroratech.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-02T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contract signed — next steps to production

Hi Samir — great to hear, and congrats to both teams. Attached is a working MAP (Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx) that combines the post-signature implementation playlist, an evaluation matrix for canary gates, and proposed training sessions. High-level summary below:

1) Commitment playlist (timeline anchors)
- Week 0 (contract day): Kickoff + environment access provisioning
- Week 1: Baseline integration test + prefix/KV cache warmup plan
- Week 2: Canary 1 (10% traffic, 48h observation) + quality evals
- Week 3: Canary 2 (50% traffic, 72h) + scale stress test
- Week 4: Cutover & full rollout; follow-up training and runbook handoff

2) Evaluation grid (attached tab):
- Success signals: latency P95 < 350ms, error rate < 0.5%, embedding cosine drift < 0.02 on sampled set
- Automated alerts + manual verification checklist for each gate

3) Training plan:
- Dev onboarding session (90 min): model routing, routing policies, SDK snippets
- SRE runbook session (90 min): canary procedures, KV cache seeding, emergency rollback
- Recordings + runbook to be posted to shared Drive link once sessions are complete

4) Security evidence: short SOC2 checklist included in attachment (SOC2_Statement_summary.pdf) — will follow up with full artifacts via secure link.

Next steps: can you confirm the Week 1–4 cadence works for Aurora? If yes we will lock dates for the two training sessions and draft the invoice milestone table in the MAP.

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2_Statement_summary.pdf

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, Samir Patel <samir@auroratech.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contract signed — next steps to production

On Thu, Dec 2, 2026 at 9:03 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Samir — great to hear...

Quick tech note from our side to make the canary evaluation concrete:
- Canary traffic split will be enforced at the routing layer (we'll provide the route rule config).
- KV/prefix cache warmup: we recommend a two-step warmup (synthetic prefix replay during Week 0, then live partial traffic in Week 1). We'll share a small script to seed the KV cache and a replay dataset (will attach deployment-checklist.csv).
- Regression evals: please surface a representative prompt set (10–20 prompts) for your payments flows; we will include automated prompt-level diffs as part of the Week 1 gate.

Operational asks for Aurora:
- Provide a read-only account for our infra team by Day 2 for metrics access (Prometheus/Grafana URLs + credentials).
- Point of contact for DB rollout and feature flags.

I will also prepare a short runbook stub we can iterate on during training. Laura — can you pick two tentative training dates (week of Dec 14 or Dec 21) and I'll sync with infra on the session agendas?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@auroratech.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: impl@auroratech.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-04T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contract signed — next steps to production

Thanks team — the Week 1–4 cadence looks good to us. A couple of clarifications before you finalize the MAP spreadsheet:
- For the canary gates, can you add explicit rollback triggers tied to our payment error budget (if charge failures increase by >0.2% over baseline for 30m, automatic rollback to previous model)?
- We prefer the first training to be on Dec 15 (dev session) and the second on Dec 18 (SRE session); both at 10:00 PT. Can you confirm facilitator names so we can send calendar invites?
- Procurement would like the invoice milestones in the MAP to be: 25% on kickoff, 35% post-Canary2, 40% on cutover.

If you can update the spreadsheet with those items and re-send, we'll get procurement and security to sign off next week.

Best,
Samir
